description: A premium, responsive demo website for a multi-branch general dentistry group. The site has no connection to an existing practice or booking system.

questions.question: Which language should the website use?

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Recommended for a maintainable, type-safe interactive website.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: Use JavaScript without static type checking.

questions.rationale: A frontend-only implementation is appropriate because booking is demo-only and no backend or practice system exists.

questions.question: Which frontend framework should the website use?

options.label: React
options.description: Recommended for a polished, component-based site with reusable page patterns.

options.label: Svelte
options.description: A compiler-based framework for interactive web experiences.

questions.rationale: React is a suitable default for a multi-page marketing website with reusable branch, service, and content templates.

questions.question: What should the website include?
questions.recommendedChoice: Premium responsive clinic-group site: home, branch and service pages, about/team, patient resources/FAQ, blog, contact, legal privacy/terms/cookie notice, demo-only booking UX, WhatsApp and click-to-call actions, sticky booking action, emergency guidance, insurance/payments, gallery/reviews, local SEO/schema, accessibility, and performance.
questions.answer: Premium responsive clinic-group site: home, branch and service pages, about/team, patient resources/FAQ, blog, contact, legal privacy/terms/cookie notice, demo-only booking UX, WhatsApp and click-to-call actions, sticky booking action, emergency guidance, insurance/payments, gallery/reviews, local SEO/schema, accessibility, and performance. Use local/static/mock content only. Booking interactions must be clearly labeled as a demonstration, must not submit or store real patient information, and must not collect sensitive health data. No database, external data store, practice-system integration, cloud provisioning, or deployment.
questions.rationale: Captured directly from the project brief; the prohibition on persistence and external connections is a critical constraint.

questions.question: Which data stores does the project need?

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: Use local/static/mock content only; do not persist project or patient data.

options.label: Blob Storage
options.description: Object storage for files and media.

questions.rationale: The brief explicitly prohibits databases, external data stores, and persistence. Use local/static/mock assets and interactions.

questions.question: Should users sign in to use application features?

options.label: Yes
options.description: Users sign in to access application features.

options.label: No
options.description: The public demo website does not require user sign-in.

questions.rationale: This is a public-facing informational/demo website with no account features.
